papers.title_en: MemLeak: Diagnosing Information Leaks in Multimodal Agent Memory
papers.evidence: 诊断多模态智能体记忆删除后的信息泄露，涉及概念擦除
papers.tldr: 多模态AI代理的记忆系统在删除事实文本后，事实仍可从保留的用户图像中恢复，因为VLM使用隐式视觉线索。本文提出信息溯源图（IPG）分类法，并构建MemLeak基准测试删除级联：直接探测成功率<1%，但通过相关文本恢复18.3%，通过图像恢复12.0%（盲基线0%），其中47%图像泄露无法通过文本恢复。内容感知语义删除将图像残留降至2.0%。该问题跨多个VLM、生产系统及真实照片存在，人机验证kappa=0.88。工作揭示了多模态记忆中的严重信息残留，强调需要视觉感知的删除方法。
papers.abstract_en: When a multimodal AI agent is asked to forget a fact, current memory systems usually delete the text entry and report success. We find that the fact can remain recoverable from retained user images, including images tagged to entirely different facts, because VLMs use implicit visual cues at inference time. We introduce the Information Provenance Graph (IPG), a taxonomy that classifies memory representations by deletion affordance. The IPG reveals that deletion fails through multiple channels. Our benchmark, MemLeak, measures this across a deletion cascade: direct probing of deletion-capable systems yields <1%, but retained correlated text enables 18.3% recovery, and retained images enable 12.0% recovery (0.0% blind baseline, 0.3% FPR) -- with 47% of image leaks not text-recoverable. Content-aware semantic deletion reduces the image residual to 2.0%. The residual appears across multiple VLMs, a production memory system, and real Unsplash-licensed photographs. Dual-annotator human validation (kappa = 0.88) confirms judge reliability.

papers.title_en: MEPA: Multi-Scale Representation Alignment for Visual Autoregressive Modeling with Mixture of Experts
papers.authors: Nuoyan Zhou, Zhijun Tu, Lei Yu, Kun Cheng, Jie Hu, Nannan Wang, Xinghao Chen
papers.evidence: 面向图像生成的视觉自回归建模
papers.tldr: 视觉自回归模型（VAR）在粗到细的多尺度生成中，低尺度捕获全局语义而高尺度关注细节，但共享架构导致优化冲突，且早期语义误差会传播。本文提出MEPA，通过尺度感知的token路由混合专家（MoE）架构实现解耦表示学习，并引入外部自监督特征进行残差聚合以增强早期语义。在ImageNet 256×256上，该模型以一半训练轮次和更小参数量达到更优FID，训练成本仅微增。结果表明，该方法显著提升了训练效率和生成质量，且优势随训练轮次增加而扩大。
papers.abstract_en: Visual AutoRegressive modeling (VAR) has pioneered a coarse-to-fine multi-scale autoregressive generative paradigm, demonstrating strong capabilities in image generation. However, VAR still suffers from inherent deficiencies in multi-scale representation learning. Specifically, lower scales primarily capture global semantics, while higher scales focus on fine-grained details. Employing a shared architecture across scales induces optimization conflicts. Moreover, due to the causal autoregressive process, inaccurate semantics at early scales can propagate and significantly degrade the final output. To address these issues, we introduce a scale-aware token-routed Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture, allowing scale-adaptive expert selection, thereby facilitating decoupled representation learning across scales. In addition, we enhance semantic modeling at early scales by incorporating external self-supervised features. Unlike naive alignment, we analyse and design a residual feature aggregation scheme tailored to the VAR paradigm. Extensive experiments show that our method significantly improves both training efficiency and generation quality. On the ImageNet 256*256 benchmark, our model achieves a superior FID compared to the dense baseline while requiring only half of the default training epochs and a smaller parameter budget, with a merely marginal increase in training cost. Moreover, the performance gap further widens with larger training epochs.

papers.title_en: Auditing Forgetting in Limited Memory Language Models
papers.evidence: 通过因果干预审计语言模型中的遗忘
papers.tldr: 现有评估无法判断删除事实是否通过参数记忆或检索路径残留。提出因果审计框架，通过三种数据库状态干预分解行为。发现参数泄漏近零，残留主要来自检索图，最高达13.6%。揭示LMLM遗忘边界主要由数据库管理员决定。
papers.abstract_en: Limited Memory Language Models (LMLMs) externalize factual knowledge to a database to enable deletion-based unlearning without retraining. Existing evaluations measure post-deletion correctness in aggregate and cannot tell whether a deleted fact persists through residual parametric memory, alternative retrieval paths, or near-neighbor retrieval artifacts. We propose a causal auditing framework that holds the model fixed and varies the database state at inference time across three interventions: FULL, DEL-ON, and DEL-OFF. The framework decomposes post-deletion behavior into parametric leakage L(f), retrieval-mediated correctness R(f), and a retrieval artifact rate grounded in the inference-time retrieval trace. We apply it to 12,228 alias-closure deletions across thirteen databases, including four adversarial topologies (Base, Alias, Noise, Collision) we construct in three domains, and six prompt formulations. Parametric leakage is near zero in every variant and every prompt style: the model rarely returns the deleted answer in the absence of retrieval. The residual that does survive lives in the retrieval graph: retrieval-mediated correctness and the retrieval artifact rate match within rounding everywhere, so post-deletion correctness is, in our audit, predominantly reconstituted from near-neighbor retrieval. This residual ranges from 0.7% on the released LMLM database to 13.6% on the most adversarial variant, and prompt formulation does not independently control how much of a deleted fact survives. These results suggest that, for this class of LMLM and deletion procedure, the unlearning boundary is drawn primarily by the database administrator rather than by the model.

papers.title_en: EquiSteer: Cross-Attention Steering Towards a Fairer Text-Guided Image Generation
papers.authors: Tatiana Gaintseva, Akshit Achara, Gregory Slabaugh, Jiankang Deng, Ismail Elezi
papers.evidence: 通过交叉注意力引导的无训练去偏方法
papers.tldr: 文本到图像扩散模型在生成如“护士”、“CEO”等提示时，因训练数据偏见导致输出性别倾向。现有去偏方法需重训练或批量控制，缺乏可扩展的逐样本方案。EquiSteer无需训练，通过预计算对比提示的引导向量，在推理时由提示感知门控清除中性提示的现有属性信号并注入目标属性，实现对交叉注意力的逐样本引导。在SD-1.5、SD-2.1、SDXL、SANA上，平均差异差距降低高达87%，且几乎不损害图像质量与对齐，为公平图像生成提供了高效灵活的解决方案。
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models power everyday creative tasks, but they still reproduce the demographic biases in their training data. On common prompts such as ``a photo of a nurse,'' ``a photo of a CEO'', they skew their outputs toward one gender, driven by the statistics of training data rather than anything in the text. Existing debiasing methods show promise in narrow settings but require retraining, batch-level control, or prompt-specific tuning, limiting their scalability. We propose \emph{EquiSteer}, a training-free method that works per sample by steering cross-attention (CA) activations at inference time. For each target attribute, EquiSteer precomputes steering vectors from contrastive prompts. Then at generation time, a prompt-aware gate leaves attribute-specific prompts untouched, while for neutral ones it clears existing attribute signals from the CA activations and injects a target attribute. Across SD-1.5, SD-2.1, SDXL, and SANA, EquiSteer reduces the average parity gap by up to $87\%$, with minimal effect on image quality and text-image alignment. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Atmyre/EquiSteer}{https://github.com/Atmyre/EquiSteer}.%

papers.title_en: The Illusion of High Utility in Safety Alignment of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.authors: Adeel Yousaf, Soumik Ghosh, James Beetham, Amrit Singh Bedi, Mubarak Shah
papers.evidence: 评估安全对齐后的效用损失，类似于文本到图像模型中的概念擦除
papers.tldr: 文本到图像扩散模型的安全对齐方法常用粗粒度指标评估，产生高效用假象。细粒度评估TIFA发现语义保真度严重下降，对象计数、属性、关系等出错。分析揭示文本编码器嵌入空间发生语义崩塌，表现为分布收缩和结构扭曲。为此提出结构感知几何正则化（SAGE），显式保持嵌入分布与提示间结构，在维持安全的同时提升结构化效用（TIFA +5.0%），打破高效用幻觉。
papers.abstract_en: Safety alignment of text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models aims to suppress harmful generations while preserving utility on benign prompts. Recent methods often appear to deliver high safety with high utility, but this conclusion rests largely on coarse global utility metrics (e.g., FID, CLIPScore) that are insensitive to fine-grained semantic correctness, creating an illusion of high utility. We show that when utility is measured with structured evaluation, this illusion breaks: on TIFA (Text-to-Image Faithfulness evaluation with Question Answering), safety-aligned models suffer substantial drops in semantic fidelity, including failures in object counts, attributes, and relationships. To diagnose the source of this gap, we analyze the text-encoder prompt embedding space and uncover semantic collapse, a contraction of embedding spread coupled with distortion of inter-prompt similarity structure, which strongly correlates with structured utility loss. Guided by this insight, we propose StructureAware Geometric Regularization (SAGE), a safety alignment objective that explicitly preserves embedding spread and inter-prompt relational structure during adaptation. Our method restores structured utility (TIFA +5.0% over prior state-of-the-art) while maintaining strong safety performance and competitive coarse-grained utility scores. Our source code and trained models are available at https://adeelyousaf.github.io/SAGE_ECCV26_Project_Page/.

papers.title_en: Training-Free Debiasing of Diffusion Models via CLIP-Guided Denoising Optimization
papers.authors: Dain Kim, Jinseo Kim, Sungyong Baik
papers.evidence: 通过引导文本嵌入实现免训练去偏，属于概念擦除的一种形式
papers.tldr: 文本到图像扩散模型存在人口统计偏见，中性提示也产生刻板印象。现有方法依赖重训练或推理时干预导致质量下降。本文提出无需训练的文本嵌入引导（TES），在扩散过程中直接优化条件文本嵌入。两阶段策略：早期全局对齐后迭代去噪时用CLIP反馈精细调整，不修改参数。在Stable Diffusion上实验，TES在公平性上超越现有无训练基线，并保持竞争力图像质量，表明推理时文本嵌入优化是实用的公平生成方案。
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models achieve impressive visual quality, yet demographic bias remains a challenge, as neutral prompts consistently produce stereotypical representations across gender and race. Existing approaches remain limited by costly retraining or by inference-time interventions that often degrade image quality and semantic alignment. We propose Text Embedding Steering (TES), a training-free framework that mitigates demographic bias by directly optimizing conditional text embeddings during the diffusion process. We show that a two-stage strategy - early-stage global alignment followed by iterative denoising-time refinement with CLIP-based feedback - enables stable and controllable attribute steering without modifying model parameters. Extensive experiments on Stable Diffusion demonstrate that TES outperforms existing training-free baselines in fairness while maintaining competitive image quality. These results highlight that inference-time text embedding optimization is a practical and scalable solution for fairness-aware generation in diffusion models.
